        {
            var list = this.Loop(args);
            if (list == null || list.Count == 0)
            {
                return;
            }

            run.EnterLoop();
            run.ParentContext.Add(list);
            for (var i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
            {
                var row = list[i];
                run.ParentContext.Add(row);
                run.SetRow(isLast: i == list.Count - 1);
                run.RemoveParent(row);
            }

            run.LeaveRow();
            run.RemoveParent(list);
            run.ExitLoop();
        }

    private partial global::Toshal.Template.Compiled.CompiledTemplate? SubTemplate(global::Toshal.Template.ProcessTemplateArgs args);

    protected override void Render(global::System.Text.StringBuilder output, object? context, global::Toshal.Template.Compiled.TemplateRun run, ref global::Toshal.Template.Compiled.TemplateScope scope)
    {
        var value0 = run.RentBuilder();
        value0.Append("outer");
        scope.Set("x", value0.ToString());
        run.ReturnBuilder(value0);
        this.ForEach0(output, context, run.LoopArgs("rows", A0, context), run, ref scope);
        ProcessSubTemplate(this.SubTemplate(run.ProcessTemplateArgs("footer", A1, context)), output, context, run, ref scope, "");
        output.Append("[");
        if (!scope.TryAppend(output, "x")) this.WriteToken(run.TokenArgs("x", A1, context), output);
        output.Append("]");
    }

    private void ForEach0(global::System.Text.StringBuilder output, object? context, global::Toshal.Template.LoopArgs args, global::Toshal.Template.Compiled.TemplateRun run, ref global::Toshal.Template.Compiled.TemplateScope scope)
    {
        var list = this.Loop(args);
        if (list == null || list.Count == 0)
        {
            return;
        }

        run.EnterLoop();
        var rowScope = global::Toshal.Template.Compiled.TemplateScope.Child(scope);
        run.ParentContext.Add(list);
        for (var i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
        {
            var row = list[i];
            run.ParentContext.Add(row);
            run.SetRow(isLast: i == list.Count - 1);
            if (!rowScope.TryAppend(output, "name")) this.WriteToken(run.TokenArgs("name", A1, row), output);
            if (run.InRowBeforeTheLast)
            {
                output.Append(",");
            }
            run.RemoveParent(row);
        }

        run.LeaveRow();
        run.RemoveParent(list);
        run.ExitLoop();
    }
}
